mapper.select: SELECT HOLIDAY_ID, HOLIDAY_DT, HOLIDAY_NM, IS_HOLIDAY_YN, GEN_TYPE_CD, SYNC_DT, DEL_YN, FRST_REG_DT FROM TB_HOLIDAY WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM HOLIDAY_DT) = #{year} ORDER BY HOLIDAY_DT ASC
SELECT HOLIDAY_ID, HOLIDAY_DT, HOLIDAY_NM, IS_HOLIDAY_YN, GEN_TYPE_CD, SYNC_DT, DEL_YN, FRST_REG_DT FROM TB_HOLIDAY WHERE HOLIDAY_ID = #{holidayId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_HOLIDAY_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_HOLIDAY ( HOLIDAY_ID, HOLIDAY_DT, HOLIDAY_NM, IS_HOLIDAY_YN, GEN_TYPE_CD, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{holidayId}, #{holidayDt}, #{holidayNm}, #{isHolidayYn}, #{genTypeCd}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_HOLIDAY T USING ( SELECT #{holidayDt} AS HOLIDAY_DT, #{holidayNm} AS HOLIDAY_NM, #{isHolidayYn} AS IS_HOLIDAY_YN FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.HOLIDAY_DT = S.HOLIDAY_DT AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.HOLIDAY_NM = S.HOLIDAY_NM, T.IS_HOLIDAY_YN = S.IS_HOLIDAY_YN, T.SYNC_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( HOLIDAY_ID, HOLIDAY_DT, HOLIDAY_NM, IS_HOLIDAY_YN, GEN_TYPE_CD, SYNC_DT, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_HOLIDAY_ID.NEXTVAL, S.HOLIDAY_DT, S.HOLIDAY_NM, S.IS_HOLIDAY_YN, 'API', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
UPDATE TB_HOLIDAY SET DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE HOLIDAY_ID = #{holidayId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
